en: A sepia-toned, vintage postcard showing the interior of a large dining or banquet hall. The room is set with long tables and many chairs, all neatly arranged with napkins and glasses. The walls are decorated with paintings and ornate moldings, and there is a small stage area at the far end with a painted backdrop depicting a landscape. The lighting suggests an early 20th-century setting. There is handwriting in French across the lower center part of the postcard. Printed text at the bottom provides location details.
